text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language to another quickly. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. This helps companies understand customer opinions. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people, answering questions and giving support. Thanks to NLP, the way we interact with technology is becoming more natural every day.
